create_location.title: Create location
create_location.description: Add a place things can be. Name it, optionally say what kind of place it is, and optionally nest it under one that already exists. The code is minted here and never changes afterwards.

list_locations.title: List locations
list_locations.description: List places, newest id last. Narrow to one place's direct children, or to the roots with no parent at all.

get_location.title: Read location
get_location.description: Read one place. A deleted one reads as missing.

update_location.title: Update location
update_location.description: Change a place's name or kind, or move it under a different parent. Moving it under itself or under one of its own descendants is refused, because that would make the tree a loop.

args.description: The place to change. The address decides which, not the body.

delete_location.title: Delete location
delete_location.description: Soft-delete a place. Refused while it still has places nested under it or things recorded as being there.

list_descendant_locations.title: List descendants
list_descendant_locations.description: Every place nested under this one at any depth, not just its direct children.

args.description: The place to walk down from.

create_asset.title: Create asset
create_asset.description: Record a thing to track. Choose serialized for one physical unit, which needs its own tag, or fungible for a type counted by quantity. Creating it establishes no balance anywhere — that only comes from the ledger.

list_assets.title: List assets
list_assets.description: List things, id order. Narrow by category, by tracking mode, or to those last seen at one place.

get_asset.title: Read asset
get_asset.description: Read one thing. A deleted one reads as missing.

update_asset.title: Update asset
update_asset.description: Change a thing's name, category, tag or attributes. The tracking mode cannot be changed after creation — every entry already in the ledger would mean something different under the other reading — and the location is the ledger's to set, not a caller's.

args.description: The thing to change. The address decides which, not the body.

delete_asset.title: Delete asset
delete_asset.description: Soft-delete a thing. Refused while any reservation against it is still open — release or commit those first.

get_asset_balance.title: Read balance
get_asset_balance.description: How much of one thing is at one place, folded from the whole ledger rather than read from a stored total. The place is required: a balance with no place named would always be zero and would hide the mistake.

args.description: The place to count it at.

post_movement.title: Post movement
post_movement.description: Append one entry to the ledger. Four shapes are postable: arrived names a destination and no origin, departed names an origin and no destination, transferred names two distinct places, and adjusted names a destination and may carry a negative quantity. A reversal is never posted here.

list_movements.title: List movements
list_movements.description: List ledger entries. Narrow to one thing, or to one kind of entry.

get_movement.title: Read movement
get_movement.description: Read one ledger entry. Entries are never edited or deleted, so what it says is what was recorded.

reverse_movement.title: Reverse movement
reverse_movement.description: Post the mirror of an entry, leaving the original untouched. The mirror swaps origin and destination, so the pair folds to no net effect. An entry may be reversed at most once, and a reversal cannot itself be reversed.

create_hold.title: Create hold
create_hold.description: Set aside a quantity of one thing at one place until a stated time. Refused if that much is not actually available once every other open reservation there is counted.

list_holds.title: List holds
list_holds.description: List reservations, id order. Narrow by thing, by place, or by where the reservation is in its life.

list_holds_expired.title: List expired holds
list_holds_expired.description: Every still-open reservation whose time has passed as of the cutoff. The sweeper passes its own idea of now rather than this reading a clock, so a test can move time without one.

args.description: The moment to judge against, RFC 3339.

commit_hold.title: Commit hold
commit_hold.description: Take up to the reserved quantity, posting a ledger entry out of the place it was held. Anything not taken is released in the same call: a reservation is committed once and there is no second commit on it afterwards.

args.description: How much to actually take, at most what was reserved.
The ledger entry to post: departed, or transferred when it is going somewhere named.
Where it is going, for a transfer.

release_hold.title: Release hold
release_hold.description: Give back a reservation with nothing taken, either because someone asked or because the sweeper found it past its time.
